commands.description: Estrazione puntuale: identifica entità e concetti chiave. Per ogni elemento, riporta la citazione testuale esatta (verbatim) e spiega perché è rilevante.
Sintesi densa: elimina ripetizioni e dettagli minori. Mantieni solo i punti informativi essenziali e i passaggi decisivi.
Filtro tematico: isola e raggruppa solo le parti del testo che trattano l'argomento specifico indicato.
Analisi strutturale: individua ed estrai le singole tesi, argomentazioni o catene di ragionamento presenti.
Comparazione: analizza due o più elementi evidenziando in modo preciso somiglianze, differenze e punti di contatto.
Fusione dati: unisci più testi in un unico output coerente, eliminando i doppioni e risolvendo eventuali contrasti tra le informazioni.
Task libero: esegui qualsiasi altra operazione richiesta non specificata sopra.

sources.name: paper
sources.description: Scientific article or academic publication, specifically focusing on Information Retrieval, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Language Modeling (LLM). Includes basic metadata (title, authors), methodological and architectural details (retrieval methods, generation models, use of knowledge graphs, rerankers, agent-based and multi-turn approaches), data information (modality, application domain), and experimental evaluation specifications (dataset, metrics, comparison baselines, and performance on benchmarks such as HotpotQA and Natural Questions).

what.name: name
what.definition: A "str" element with the following description "the name of the paper."

what.name: author
what.definition: A "str" element with the following description "the author of the paper."

what.name: topic
what.definition: A "str" element with the following description "the main research area or technique discussed in the paper, choose one from ['Information Retrieval', 'Retrieval-Augmented Generation', 'Data Selection', 'SFT']."

what.name: uses_knowledge_graph
what.definition: A "str" element with the following description "whether the method explicitly incorporates a knowledge graph as part of retrieval or reasoning choose one from ['Yes', 'No']."

what.name: reasoning_depth
what.definition: A "str" element with the following description "reasoning path length in the application scenarios of the method by the main task or benchmark, choose one from ['single-hop', 'multi-hop']."

what.name: baseline
what.definition: A "str" element with the following description "baseline model or system used for comparison in the experiments, list all the baselines mentioned in the text."

what.name: retrieval_method
what.definition: A "str" element with the following description "primary retrieval method used to obtain supporting information, choose one from ['Dense Retrieval', 'Graph-based Retrieval', 'Hybrid Retrieval', 'Sparse Retrieval', 'Web Search', 'other']."

what.name: generator_model
what.definition: A "str" element with the following description "name of the generation models used in the system (e.g., GPT-4o-mini, LLaMa2-7B-Chat), list all the baselines mentioned in the text."

what.name: uses_reranker
what.definition: A "str" element with the following description "whether the system uses an explicit reranker stage to re-score retrieved candidates before generation, choose one from ['Yes', 'No']."

what.name: data_modality
what.definition: A "str" element with the following description "all modality of the input data handled by the system, choose one or more from ['Audio', 'Image', 'Table', 'Text', 'Code'], e.g. Text; Table; Image."

what.name: evaluation_dataset
what.definition: A "str" element with the following description "name of the dataset(s) used for evaluation in the experiments, list all the datasets mentioned in the text."

what.name: evaluation_metric
what.definition: A "str" element with the following description "all the evaluation metric(s) reported in the experiments (e.g.,  Perplexity; BLEU; ROUGE; F1; recall@1)."

what.name: application_domain
what.definition: A "str" element with the following description "primary real-world domain or application scenario targeted by the paper, choose one or more from ['General', 'Education', 'Finance', 'Sports', 'Government', 'Legal', 'Medical', 'Academic', 'Art', 'Other'], e.g. Education; Finance"

what.name: use_agent
what.definition: A "str" element with the following description "whether the system explicitly adopts an agent-style architecture (e.g., tool-calling or multi-step planning) rather than a single forward pass, choose one from ['Yes', 'No']."

what.name: agent_framework
what.definition: A "str" element with the following description "main agent-style reasoning framework used by the system, choose one from ['CoT', 'ToT', 'Multi-Agent Collaboration', 'Other'], if the system does not use agent, leave it empty."

what.name: performance_on_hotpotqa
what.definition: A "multi_str" element with the following description "the result or performance of the method on the HotpotQA benchmark. Extract any reported metric(s) such as F1, EM, accuracy, or other values. If multiple metrics are provided, separate them with `||`. If only qualitative descriptions are given (e.g., 'outperforms baseline'), extract them in short free text."

what.name: performance_on_NQ
what.definition: A "str" element with the following description "the result or performance of the method on the Natural Questions (NQ) benchmark. Extract any reported metric(s) or qualitative descriptions. Use short free-form text if no specific numbers are given."

what.name: multi_turn_retrieval
what.definition: A "str" element with the following description "whether the method explicitly supports multi-turn retrieval. Only choose one from ['Yes', 'No']."

what.name: baseline_amount
what.definition: A "int" element with the following description "the number of baselines in this paper."
